userRequest: 感觉这个进入画卷之后诗句占空间有点少，导致很多留白看起来不好看，你想一下可以怎么完善一下，然后调用 imagegen 给我出一个设计稿我看看

inputImages.role: edit target; real current desktop website

prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity desktop website design proposal, a complete post-entry Jiangxue poetry scene, landscape 16:10. Render a flat straight-on browser content view with crisp Chinese typesetting, no device frame or external annotations.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current real PoeticRealm desktop screenshot. Redesign its poetry layout and supporting UI only. Preserve the existing 3D background composition, camera, snow mountains, rocky shore, bare tree, river reflections, solitary wooden boat and fisherman. Preserve their present visual quality and sizes; this must be an achievable typography/layout proposal for this exact website.

Primary request: the existing four poem columns are too tiny and crowded in the upper left, leaving a large visually unbalanced empty area below. Make the poem an intentional, substantially larger visual anchor on the left, balanced against the boat on the right. Maintain the immersive full-bleed 3D scene.

Layout:
1. Keep the current slim dark ink-teal 64px top navigation, same brand and navigation hierarchy.
2. Move the main title/poetry composition lower and inward from the top-left corner. It should occupy approximately x=7–44% of viewport width and y=18–78% of viewport height. The title “江雪” in elegant restrained Chinese Songti serif sits above the poem; the small author “唐 · 柳宗元” sits alongside the title. Do not make the title larger than the poem's overall visual weight.
3. The complete poem is the dominant typographic element: four equal columns, vertical top-to-bottom, reading columns RIGHT TO LEFT. The RIGHTMOST column is “千山鸟飞绝”, the next left is “万径人踪灭”, the next left is “孤舟蓑笠翁”, and the LEFTMOST is “独钓寒江雪”. Exactly these 20 Chinese characters, once each in their specified column; no punctuation or duplicated verses. All columns start at the same height and end at the same height; identical column gaps.
4. Increase poem type to about 60px at a 1440x900 reference viewport, about 2.2x the screenshot. Spacious but controlled vertical character spacing, 5 characters per column extending roughly y=29–73% of the screen. Four columns span about 30% of viewport width. Use warm ivory, legible gentle WenKai-style regular type; refined readable calligraphy, not wild cursive, not heavy brush lettering. The website's poetic typography and homepage poetic slogan share this same type role. Preserve the real scene visible between columns.
5. Retain a soft ink-teal shading behind the left reading region for contrast; feather it smoothly into the actual river. No bounded panel, scroll illustration, paper rectangle, or hard vertical split. The boat and fisherman remain completely unobscured.
6. Reduce the visual heaviness of the many bottom rectangular buttons. Put “收藏本诗” and “笺注 · 译文” as two restrained small text-and-line-icon actions beneath the poetry. Group the scene controls in one compact quiet row at bottom right: “播放”, “声音”, “重看”, “选景”, “全屏”. The 选景 action represents the existing view choices. Thin strokes, understated separators, generous clickable spacing, minimal borders, no oversized filled tiles.
7. Remove the current thick opaque bottom caption bar. Retain the tiny location “永州 · 潇水” at bottom left and tiny caption “寒江细雪 · 孤舟独钓” at bottom right directly over the scene, with appropriate contrast. A subtle small “拖动观景 · 滚轮缩放” instruction may sit just above the scene control row.

Exact top navigation text: “← 返回总览”, “诗境 · 一卷山河”, “诗词总览”, “我的收藏”, “个人中心”. Keep the existing small red brand seal. Brand alone uses the distinctive running-script treatment; UI labels use clear Chinese sans-serif; title uses Songti; poem uses WenKai.
Palette: retain the current cold blue-green river, gray-white snow, dark teal UI and warm ivory type. Calm modern Eastern digital artwork, close to the actual product screenshot.
Constraints: change UI composition and typography only. Do not substitute a newly painted landscape or photorealistic concept landscape. Do not add people, objects, buildings, particles, mountains, boats, decorative seals, blossoms, or prose. No game HUD, neon, gold palace styling, glassmorphism, arbitrary English labels, marketing headlines, charts, cards, browser chrome, mockup labels, or watermark. No side panel squeezing the 3D viewport. Keep the entire four-line poem readable and the right-hand model visible. Deliver ONE finished design mockup, not a collage or comparison board.
scope: design image only; no frontend or model changes
